verses.text: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
lines: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land.
You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

verses.text: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin.
lines: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people.
You have covered all their sin.

verses.text: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
lines: You have taken away all your wrath.
You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

verses.text: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
lines: Turn us, God of our salvation,
and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

verses.text: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
lines: Will you be angry with us forever?
Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

verses.text: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
lines: Won’t you revive us again,
that your people may rejoice in you?

verses.text: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
lines: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh.
Grant us your salvation.

verses.text: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
lines: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak,
for he will speak peace to his people, his saints;
but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.text: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
lines: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him,
that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
lines: Mercy and truth meet together.
Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.text: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
lines: Truth springs out of the earth.
Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

verses.text: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
lines: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good.
Our land will yield its increase.

verses.text: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.
lines: Righteousness goes before him,
And prepares the way for his steps.
